West Indies Coach Sees India Series as ODI Cricket Test

West Indies coach Daren Sammy has described the upcoming three-match ODI series against India as a significant test for his team. The team has not won a bilateral ODI series in India in 24 years. Sammy aims to assess the team's progress ahead of next year's World Cup qualifiers.
